title: group related labels fields
rule: Visually group related labels and fields; put each label close to its field (not equidistant from several).
pass_when: Related fields share a visual group; each label is closer to its own field than to neighbors.
fail_when: Related fields are ungrouped, or a label sits equally between two controls.
overview: Group related fields visually; keep each label closer to its own control.
apply_when: Forms with related field clusters or multi-control rows.
not_when: Single isolated fields with no related neighbors to group.
agent_hint: Cluster related fields; place each label nearer its field than neighbors.
description: Visually group related labels and fields; put each label close to its field, not equidistant from several. Pass when related fields share a visual group and each label is closer to its own field than to neighbors; fail when related fields are ungrouped or a label sits equally between two controls. Proximity carries ownership without inventing extra grouping chrome.
